div.div: 3 رافث صَاحِبَهُ , inf. n. مُرَافَثَةٌ, [He joined with his companion, or vied with him, in foul, unseemly, immodest, lewd, or obscene, conversation, in relation to women: and in talking plainly of what should be indicated allusively, relating to coition.] (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
